integration_issues.flow: Student lifecycle screen — dvsa_syllabus_tracking auto-seed on first visit
integration_issues.issue: One remaining HTTP 400 from Supabase when opening Jamie's lifecycle screen. Captured URL: POST https://otqokumouwrwyylpruqt.supabase.co/rest/v1/dvsa_syllabus_tracking?columns=%22student_id%22%2C%22manoeuvre%22%2C%22category_key%22%2C%22category_name%22%2C%22competency_level%... — the `?columns=` querystring is PostgREST's INSERT syntax, so this is NOT a SELECT that a UUID guard would catch. Root cause: /app/frontend/src/supabaseDb.ts line 933 `seedCompetenciesIfEmpty(studentId)` runs whenever listCompetencies returns 0 rows (which is now the normal case for Jamie because the SELECT succeeds with an empty list). The INSERT of 20 DVSA_SYLLABUS rows then fails — most likely an RLS policy (owner Alex inserting on behalf of student Jamie) or a column mismatch on the dvsa_syllabus_tracking table. Non-blocking: the app renders correctly, Competency tab shows the seeded-empty state gracefully. NOT introduced by the UUID guard fix — it was previously hidden behind the earlier 400 on the SELECT. Reference: /app/frontend/src/supabaseDb.ts:933-947, /app/frontend/src/useSupabaseData.ts:281-300.

action_items: (P3) Guard the INSERT path too: in /app/frontend/src/supabaseDb.ts:933 (seedCompetenciesIfEmpty) either (a) verify the caller has RLS insert privilege by moving the seed into a Postgres trigger, or (b) wrap the insert in try/catch and swallow the RLS 40x with a console.debug so it stops polluting the browser console. Alternatively, run the seed once server-side when a student is created rather than on every lifecycle screen open.
(P4) Confirm dvsa_syllabus_tracking RLS policy allows owner-role instructors (Alex) to INSERT rows for their school's students — currently the policy appears to deny it.

critical_code_review_comments: seedCompetenciesIfEmpty() side-effects on every lifecycle screen render is a design smell — it silently ignores insert failures via the `if (error) throw error` bubbling into useCompetencies' try/finally, but the browser console still logs the raw fetch 400. Consider moving syllabus seeding to a Postgres trigger on students insert, or into the /api/v2/students POST handler on the FastAPI side, so the client never sees the 400.
The three UUID_RE guards (useSupabaseData.ts:190, useSupabaseData.ts:568, supabaseDb.ts:921) are correct and effective — verified: lessons and test_outcomes 400s are gone. Nicely scoped fix.

rca_of_issue: For the remaining dvsa_syllabus_tracking 400 (not part of the current fix scope): useCompetencies hook always calls seedCompetenciesIfEmpty() after listCompetencies() returns []. When Jamie has no prior syllabus rows, the seed function INSERTs 20 DVSA syllabus rows keyed on Jamie's UUID. That INSERT is being rejected by PostgREST with 400. Given student_id is a valid UUID (verified via URL param) and Jamie belongs to Alex's school (Alex is signed-in owner), the most likely cause is the dvsa_syllabus_tracking table's RLS policy not permitting the owner role to insert on behalf of a student, OR a required NOT NULL column (like a check constraint on competency_level enum, or the school_id/instructor_id FK) missing from the payload built at supabaseDb.ts:936-944. Mitigation: catch and console.debug the error so it doesn't pollute the console, and/or move the seed into a Postgres AFTER INSERT trigger on the students table.
